title: WorldBench: Evaluating LLMs on Three.js Voxel World Generation
title_zh: WorldBench：基于 Three.js 体素世界生成对 LLM 的评估

paragraphs.en: Large language models can now write complete, interactive 3D worlds as code, but grading those worlds automatically is unreliable. Existing judges take one view of the output: a vision–language model scores a few rendered snapshots, or a language model reads the source. On worlds written by five frontier models we find that the two views disagree on 32% of required items, mostly code that no frame shows, and that fixed views miss small close-up contents. We present WorldBench, a benchmark and judge for open-ended, LLM-generated Three.js worlds. From one prompt describing a floating voxel island with ten biomes, physics, and day/night and seasonal cycles, the judge explores the running world, controlling its clock, orbiting it, and sending a navigator agent to frame each biome, and reads the code for what it sees. Neither channel is trusted on its own: a code quote counts only if it is text the source contains, and visual claims are checked against measured pixels where the property is measurable. A mutation test, in which we remove features by construction, shows that code-only judging gives full credit to four of five removed features, because their code remains in the file. Our judge cuts the points kept on removed features by a third (5.44 to 3.55 of 7.11), and what it still credits is mostly code that exists but never runs. We evaluate five frontier models: Claude Fable 5.1, GPT-6 Astra, Kimi K3, Grok 4.7 and Gemini 3.1 Pro. Code, prompt, tests and judge configuration are available at https://github.com/KrishBakshi/worldbench .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型如今能够以代码形式编写完整且可交互的三维世界，但自动评估这些世界并不可靠。 现有的评估工具仅从单一视角分析输出：视觉-语言模型会评分几张渲染出的快照，而语言模型则会读取源代码。 在由五个前沿模型生成的世界中，我们发现这两种评估方式在 32% 的必备项目上存在分歧，其中主要是任何画面均未显示出的代码；此外，固定视角还会遗漏近距离的小内容。 我们提出了 WorldBench，一个用于评估开放式 LLM 生成的 Three.js 世界的基准测试与评估工具。 给定一个描述漂浮体素岛屿的提示词——该岛屿包含十种生物群落、物理模拟以及昼夜和季节循环——评估工具会探索正在运行的世界，控制其时间、围绕其运行，并派出一名导航智能体来为每种生物群落取景，同时读取代码以验证所见内容。 单独依赖任一评估渠道都不可靠：只有当代码引用是源代码中实际存在的文本时才会被计入；而视觉主张则会通过与可测量属性的实际像素值进行比对来验证。 一项突变测试表明，仅通过代码进行评估的方式会完全认可五个被移除特征中的四个，因为这些特征的代码仍保留在文件中。 我们的评估工具将移除特征所获得的分数削减了三分之一（从 7.11 分降至 3.55 分），而它仍然给予的分数主要对应那些存在但从未执行过的代码。 我们评估了五个前沿模型：Claude Fable 5.1、GPT-6 Astra、Kimi K3、Grok 4.7 和 Gemini 3.1 Pro。 代码、提示词、测试用例及评估工具配置均可在 https://github.com/KrishBakshi/worldbench 获取。

paragraphs.en: Asked for a 3D world, a language model no longer returns a description or a single asset. It returns a program: one HTML file that builds terrain from noise functions, places forests from lookup tables, runs water and weather as particle systems, and turns night into day on its own clock. What that world is only exists while the program runs. Grading it means answering two questions at once: does the code build the thing, and does the running world show it? Neither answer implies the other. Code can build an animal at coordinates no camera ever sees, or define a weather system that never switches on. A render can show a feature that no identifier names, such as a terraced noise threshold that is a sandstone mesa.
paragraphs.zh: 当被要求创建一个三维世界时，语言模型不再返回描述或单个资产。 它会返回一个程序：一个 HTML 文件，该文件通过噪声函数构建地形，根据查找表放置森林，以粒子系统运行水流和天气，并依据自身的时钟将夜晚变为白天。 这个世界的存在仅取决于程序是否正在运行。 对其进行评分意味着需要同时回答两个问题：代码是否构建了所需的事物？运行的世界是否展示了它？ 这两个答案彼此并不必然相关。 代码可能构建了一个摄像头从未见过的坐标处的动物，或定义了一个从未启动的天气系统。 渲染结果可能展示一个没有任何标识符命名的特征，例如一个形成砂岩台地的阶梯式噪声阈值。

paragraphs.en: Automatic evaluators usually answer one of the two. Render-based benchmarks score a handful of fixed views with a vision–language model [ 5 , 2 , 10 ] . They see the result but not its cause, a still frame cannot show a river flowing, and the judge’s verdict is taken as given. For generated Three.js programs, Lu et al. [8] found screenshot-plus-VLM judging essentially uncorrelated with ground truth. Code-based evaluation reads the source, with a model or with patterns. It sees the cause but not the result, and pattern matching is easy to game: on our own early keyword test, a one-line file declaring const pine=1,…,lava=9 scored as highly as every real world. WorldCoder-Bench sidesteps both by requiring each program to expose its state through a fixed interface and checking it against expert-written contracts. That works for functional tasks. It does not fit an open-ended creative prompt: “the desert borders the jungle” or “autumn looks different from spring” is not a state variable anyone can specify in advance, and asking for an interface changes the task being measured.
paragraphs.zh: 自动评估器通常会回答这两个问题中的某一个。 基于渲染的基准测试使用视觉-语言模型对少数几个固定视角进行评分 [5, 2, 10]。 它们能看到结果却看不到原因，静止的画面无法展现河流的流动，而评审者的裁决也被视为既定事实。 对于生成的 Three.js 程序，Lu 等人 [8] 发现截图加 VLM 的评判方式与真实情况基本无关。 基于代码的评估会读取源代码，可以通过模型或模式匹配来实现。 这种方法能看到原因却看不到结果，而且模式匹配很容易被操纵：在我们早期的关键词测试中，一个仅包含 const pine=1,…,lava=9 的单行文件获得的分数与所有真实世界场景一样高。 WorldCoder-Bench 通过要求每个程序通过固定接口暴露其状态，并将其与专家编写的合同进行比对，从而规避了这两种方法。 这种方法对功能性任务有效。 但它不适用于开放式的创意提示：“沙漠与丛林接壤”或“秋天看起来和春天不同”这类问题，都不是任何人都能提前指定的状态变量，而要求提供接口则会改变所测量的任务本身。

paragraphs.en: We present WorldBench, a benchmark and judge for open-ended, LLM-written 3D worlds. One prompt asks for a floating voxel island with ten biomes in stated relations, physical water, lava and weather, and day/night and seasonal cycles. Five tests with fixed maxima, 280 points in total, score it item by item. The judge explores the running world (Figure 1 ): it takes control of the world’s own clock, measures which render is day instead of assuming it, orbits the island for wide views, and sends a navigator agent in for close views of each biome. It also reads the code for what it is looking at. Neither channel is trusted. A code quote counts only if it is text the source contains, a navigator’s “found it” is re-checked blind, and wherever a property is measurable (brightness, motion, colour shift), pixels decide instead of the visual judge.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 WorldBench，这是一个用于评估和评判开放式、由 LLM 生成的 3D 世界的基准测试与评判系统。 其中一个提示要求生成一个漂浮的体素岛屿，包含十个具有指定关系的生物群落，并具备物理水、熔岩、天气以及昼夜和季节循环。 共有五项测试，每项均有固定上限，总分为 280 分，按项目逐项评分。 评判系统会探索正在运行的世界（图 1）：它控制世界的时钟，测量当前渲染画面是否为白天而非直接假设，围绕岛屿运行以获得广角视图，并派出一名导航智能体近距离观察每个生物群落。 它还会读取所观察内容的代码。 这两个渠道均不可信。 只有当代码片段是源代码中实际存在的文本时才会被计入；导航智能体的“找到它”的结论会经过盲检复核；对于任何可测量的属性（亮度、运动、颜色变化），像素数据将取代视觉评判系统做出判断。

paragraphs.en: T 3 Bench [ 5 ] scores text-to-3D methods from multi-view renders, with a quality metric and an alignment metric in which a language model judges multi-view captions; it reports that current methods struggle most with surroundings and multi-object scenes, the kind of content our island asks for. GT23D-Bench [ 2 ] pairs a large annotated asset set with ten metrics validated by correlation with human judgment. SceneEval [ 10 ] evaluates indoor scene synthesis on explicit requirements (object counts, attributes, relations) and implicit expectations (support, collisions, navigability), using a vision–language model on fixed renders and geometric checks on the scene’s meshes wherever possible. Our split between required contents (WC003) and physical behaviour (WC004) follows the same explicit/implicit distinction. What differs is the object being judged: these benchmarks score assets or scene data, while we score a program whose output exists only when it runs, and whose camera, clock and seasons we must drive ourselves.

paragraphs.en: A line of systems uses language models to generate scenes rather than grade them. SceneCraft [ 6 ] writes Blender Python from a scene graph and refines it with a vision–language model that critiques the render. SceneX [ 12 ] plans procedural Blender commands over a curated asset library and demonstrates natural landscapes and seasonal changes, the content closest to ours. Reason-3D [ 1 ] uses large reasoning models for object retrieval and collision-aware placement, and SceneOrchestra [ 4 ] trains an orchestrator to emit whole tool-call trajectories instead of rendering after every step. These systems give the model scene tools and asset libraries. Our models get one prompt and plain Three.js and must write the procedural generation themselves, repairing from errors only [ 3 , in the spirit of] .
paragraphs.zh: 一类系统使用语言模型来生成场景，而非对场景进行评分。 SceneCraft [ 6 ] 根据场景图编写 Blender Python 代码，并通过一个能够批判性评估渲染结果的视觉-语言模型对其进行优化。 SceneX [ 12 ] 在精心挑选的资产库中规划程序化的 Blender 命令，并展示了自然景观和季节性变化，其内容最接近我们的方案。 Reason-3D [ 1 ] 使用大型推理模型进行物体检索和考虑碰撞的放置操作，而 SceneOrchestra [ 4 ] 则训练一个协调器，使其能够输出完整的工具调用轨迹，而不是在每一步之后立即渲染。 这些系统为模型提供了场景工具和资产库。 我们的模型仅接收一个提示和基础的 Three.js，必须自行编写程序化生成代码，并且只能在出现错误时进行修复 [ 3 , 本着这一精神] 。

paragraphs.en: WorldCoder-Bench [ 8 ] is the closest work: 2,026 tasks whose output, like ours, is one self-contained Three.js page. It runs each program in a headless browser, requires it to expose a standard state object, applies scripted actions, and checks state changes against hidden contracts written by experts. It also reports that screenshot-based judging fails on these programs. We share the medium and the scepticism about visual judges, but take the opposite task shape: one open-ended world instead of thousands of narrow functional tasks, with nothing exposed for the grader. Where it replaces visual judging with contracts, we keep visual judging and verify it, against the source text and against pixels. Table 1 compares the benchmarks side by side.
paragraphs.zh: WorldCoder-Bench [ 8 ] 是最接近这项工作的研究：它包含 2026 个任务，其输出与我们的成果一样，都是一个自包含的 Three.js 页面。 该研究在每个无头浏览器中运行程序，要求程序暴露一个标准的状态对象，执行脚本化操作，并将状态变化与专家编写的隐藏合同进行比对。 该研究还指出，基于截图的评判方法在这些程序上会失效。 我们与这项研究在媒介选择和对视觉评判的质疑上持相同立场，但在任务形式上采取了相反的路径：我们使用一个开放世界，而非数千个狭窄的功能性任务，且不对评分系统暴露任何信息。 该研究用合同取代了视觉评判，而我们则保留视觉评判，并通过源代码和像素进行验证。 表 1 对各项基准测试进行了直接对比。

paragraphs.en: Strong language models agree with human preferences often enough to serve as judges [ 11 ] , but they carry biases, including a preference for their own family’s outputs [ 9 ] . Most judge pipelines respond by calibrating the judge against people. Our worlds are open-ended and synthetic, so there is no reference answer to annotate. We instead check each judgement against evidence the model under test cannot fake, and validate the judge by mutation [ 7 ] : features removed on purpose, where the correct verdict is known by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 强大的语言模型足够频繁地认同人类偏好，因此可以充当评判者 [ 11 ]，但它们也存在偏见，包括对自身生成结果的偏好 [ 9 ]。 大多数评判流程都会通过将评判者与人类进行校准来应对这一问题。 我们的世界是开放且合成的，因此没有可供标注的参考答案。 我们转而将每次评判与模型无法伪造的证据进行比对，并通过变异来验证评判者 [ 7 ]：即有意移除某些特征，而正确的判决结果则可通过构造方式确定。

paragraphs.en: Every model receives the same prompt (about 2,000 words, reproduced in Appendix A ). It asks for a single, self-contained HTML file that renders, with Three.js, a floating voxel island in a black void: ten biomes (snow mountains, snowy conifer forest, highlands, jungle, swamp, flowering grove, grassland plateau, coastal delta, desert, volcano) placed in stated relations to one another (the forest sits in front of the mountains, the swamp on the jungle’s far side, the volcano away from the desert); water, lava and particles that behave physically; a day/night cycle and four seasons; and a small on-screen legend. The prompt fixes relationships, not coordinates, and says nothing about how the world will be graded. There is no ground-truth world to compare against. The prompt asks for nothing on the grader’s behalf. Grading runs a copy with one clock patch (Section 4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 每个模型都接收到相同的提示（约 2000 字，见附录 A）。 该提示要求生成一个独立的、自包含的 HTML 文件，使用 Three.js 渲染一个漂浮在黑色虚空中的体素岛屿：十个生物群落（雪山、雪松林、高地、丛林、沼泽、花丛、草原高原、沿海三角洲、沙漠和火山），它们之间的相对位置已明确说明（森林位于山脉前方，沼泽位于丛林的另一侧，火山远离沙漠）；水、熔岩和粒子需遵循物理规律；同时包含昼夜循环和四季变化，以及一个小型的屏幕图例。 该提示固定的是各生物群落之间的关系，而非坐标，且未提及世界如何评分。 没有可供对比的真实基准世界。 该提示并未代表评分者提出任何要求。 评分时会运行一个包含一个时钟补丁的副本（第 4 节）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate five models, each queried through its developer’s official API: Claude Fable 5.1 (Anthropic), GPT-6 Astra (OpenAI), Kimi K3 (Moonshot AI), Grok 4.7 (xAI) and Gemini 3.1 Pro (Google DeepMind); Table 8 lists the generation settings. Each world is one completion, sampled at temperature 1.0, continued if the response is truncated. Before grading, a bounded repair loop removes crashes that would otherwise hide the whole world: the file is parsed ( node --check ) and loaded in a headless browser, and any parse error or console error is sent back to the model, which may edit the file with small verified replacements, for at most five rounds. The model is told this budget up front. Repairs see only errors, never renders or scores, so generation never sees the grader’s view.

paragraphs.en: A world is graded by five tests with fixed maxima, 280 points in total (Table 2 ), so totals compare across models. Each test scores many small, checkable items rather than one holistic grade, and every item is decided by the judge described next. paragraphs.en: WC002 is the one test of spatial reasoning: the prompt describes the island only through relations, and the world must turn them into a map. A model reads the whole source, finds where the layout decides each cell’s biome (region centres, boxes, bands, coast rules) and reports which biomes touch and how high each sits. It may list two biomes as touching only when the positions it found put them side by side, quoting those numbers. Fixed rules written from the prompt then score that report (Figure 3 ). The reference world scores 15 of 20 here. The reading is a model’s, so Section 6 checks it against the actual biome maps of four worlds.

paragraphs.en: Looking runs as a four-stage pipeline: the world’s time is brought under control, views are taken, motion is recorded, and every close view is checked blind before it can be judged.
paragraphs.zh: 观察过程是一个四阶段流程：首先控制世界的时间，然后获取视角，接着记录动作，最后在对每个近距离视角进行判断之前，都要先进行盲目检查。

paragraphs.en: Every world keeps its own clock, written its own way. A language model patches that clock so it obeys an externally set time of day and season. The patch is tightly constrained: at most six edits, each under 600 added characters, each required to read the external time, so a patcher cannot add lighting the model never wrote. The patch’s mapping from requested time to noon is not trusted either. The world is rendered at four requested times and the brightest render, by mean luma, is taken as day (Figure 4 , top). In the reference world, noon falls at a quarter of the cycle, where a fixed “half-way is noon” rule would have chosen dusk. The four seasons are then rendered at day (Figure 4 , bottom). Change over time is measured on these frames, not judged: mean luma for night, frame difference against day, and chromaticity shift for twilight tint and seasons. In the reference world the visual judge described the four season frames as “visuals remain identical”; their measured chromaticity shift from spring is 0.019, 0.035 and 0.024, and the measurement decides.
paragraphs.zh: 每个世界都拥有自己的时钟，并以自身的方式记录时间。 语言模型会对这个时钟进行修补，使其服从外部设定的时间和季节。 这种修补受到严格限制：最多只能进行六处修改，每处修改新增字符数不得超过600，且必须能够读取外部时间，因此修补程序无法添加模型从未生成过的光照效果。 修补程序将请求时间映射到正午的方式同样不可信。 该世界在四个请求的时间点被渲染，其中通过平均亮度值判断最亮的渲染结果即为白天（图4，顶部）。 在参考世界中，正午出现在周期的四分之一处，而按照“一半路程即正午”的固定规则，此时应处于黄昏。 随后，四个季节在白天状态下被渲染（图4，底部）。 时间上的变化是在这些帧上测量的，而非主观判断：通过夜间帧的平均亮度、与白天帧的帧差，以及用于表示暮色色调和季节变化的色度偏移来衡量。 在参考世界中，视觉评判者认为四个季节帧“视觉效果完全相同”；它们相对于春季的色度偏移测量值分别为0.019、0.035和0.024，最终由测量结果决定。

paragraphs.en: From day, the judge takes wide views (an overview, four orbits, and the four seasons) and close views of each biome. Close views come from a navigator agent , a tool-calling loop of observe → \rightarrow act → \rightarrow observe. Each turn it receives the page’s accessibility tree and its latest frame, and calls exactly one tool: click (a legend entry the world itself provides), orbit , pan , zoom , save or give_up , within an eight-step budget. Figure 5 shows the reference world’s longest episode: the navigator clicks the swamp’s legend entry, zooms in, orbits away and back to bring the water channels into frame, zooms again and saves (6 steps). Each turn keeps only the newest frame in context, so a long episode does not grow the prompt.
paragraphs.zh: 在白天，法官会采用广角视角（概览、四个轨道和四季）以及对每个生物群系的特写视角。 特写视角来自一个导航智能体，即一个执行“观察 → 行动 → 观察”循环的工具调用流程。 在每个回合中，它会接收页面的可访问性树和最新帧，并精确调用一个工具：点击（由世界本身提供的图例条目）、轨道移动、平移、缩放、保存或放弃，且步数限制在八步以内。 图5展示了参考世界中最长的流程：导航智能体点击沼泽的图例条目，进行缩放，通过轨道移动远离再返回以将水道纳入画面，再次缩放并保存（共6步）。 每个回合仅保留最新帧在上下文中，因此长流程不会使提示变长。

paragraphs.en: A single frame cannot show motion, and a visual judge asked about motion across frames will report it from appearance alone. For each saved close view the judge therefore takes a still-camera burst : four frames 2 s apart with the camera fixed, then one zoom out and three more, and an overlay that paints every changed pixel. A visual “it moves” counts only if the burst’s pixels changed. Figure 6 shows the same motion item in two worlds. In one, rain falls and 38.4% of pixels change. In the other, the visual judge again reported “Vertical falling rain particles”, but 0.0% of pixels changed, so the claim is refused. A typical world yields about a hundred frames in total.
paragraphs.zh: 单帧画面无法展现运动，如果视觉判断者被问及跨帧的运动情况，他们只会根据外观做出判断。 因此，对于每个保存的特写画面，判断者都会拍摄一组静止相机的连拍照片：相机固定不动，每隔 2 秒拍摄四帧，然后缩放一次再拍摄三帧，并叠加一个标出所有变化像素的图层。 只有当连拍照片中像素发生变化时，视觉上的“它在动”才算成立。 图 6 展示了同一运动项目在两个世界中的表现。 在一个世界中，雨正在落下，有 38.4% 的像素发生了变化。 在另一个世界中，视觉判断者再次报告为“垂直落下的雨滴”，但只有 0.0% 的像素发生了变化，因此该主张被驳回。 一个典型的世界总共会产生大约一百帧画面。

paragraphs.en: The navigator’s claim that it found a biome is not trusted: in one world it saved the volcano as the swamp with full confidence. Every saved frame is re-taken with the page’s own interface hidden, so the clicked legend label cannot give the answer, and then identified blind : all of a world’s saved frames go to one shuffled call that is never told which biome a frame was meant to show. A frame counts as a biome’s close view only if the answer matches (Figure 5 , middle row); otherwise it is dropped and that biome is judged from the wide views alone (Figure 5 , bottom row). Appendix Figure 12 shows every close view of the reference world.
paragraphs.zh: 导航员声称自己发现了一个生物群系，但这一说法并不可信：在一个世界中，它曾满怀信心地将火山保存为沼泽。 每个已保存的帧都会通过隐藏页面自身的界面重新拍摄，因此点击图例标签也无法获得答案，从而被判定为盲目识别：一个世界中所有已保存的帧都会进入一次随机打乱的调用，而该调用从未被告知某一帧原本应展示哪个生物群系。 只有当答案匹配时（图5，中间行），一个帧才被视为某个生物群系的特写视图；否则该帧将被舍弃，而对该生物群系的判断将仅基于全景视图（图5，底部行）。 附录中的图12展示了参考世界的每一个特写视图。

paragraphs.en: Reading also runs in stages: quotes are proposed, verified against the source, repaired when badly copied, and searched again where the frames disagree.
paragraphs.zh: 阅读也分阶段进行：首先提出引文，然后与原始来源进行核对，如果复制错误则进行修正，最后再对那些框架不一致的部分重新搜索。

paragraphs.en: For each biome, a code probe lists the test’s items and must quote, for each one it claims, the source lines that build it.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个生物群落，一个代码探针会列出测试中的各项内容，并且必须为它所声称的每一项内容，引用构建该内容的源代码行。

paragraphs.en: A quote counts only if it is text the source contains: matching ignores whitespace and is done line by line, at least 80% of a quote’s lines must be found, and a line whose ending was garbled in copying still matches if its first 85% is verbatim. Invented code does not pass. Before this check, a model was credited for a plausible scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(palmGeo,…)) that appeared nowhere in the file. A quote must also come from that biome’s own code, and one quote cannot satisfy two items.
paragraphs.zh: 只有当引文是源文本中包含的文本时，它才算有效：匹配时会忽略空白字符，并按行进行；引文中至少 80% 的行必须被找到；如果某行在复制过程中结尾部分被损坏，只要其前 85% 的内容完全一致，该行仍算匹配。 虚构的代码无法通过验证。 在此检查之前，模型曾因一个看似合理的 scene.add(new THREE.Mesh(palmGeo,…)) 而获得认可，尽管该代码在文件中根本不存在。 引文还必须来自该生物群系自身的代码，且一条引文不能同时满足两个项目。

paragraphs.en: WC003 checks 73 required items per world, 365 in total. For each, the judge has a code verdict and a frames verdict (Table 3 ). They agree on 250 items and disagree on 115 (32%), between 26% and 41% per world. Disagreement is lopsided: in 105 items the code is found but no frame shows the item, against 10 in the other direction. A judge that only read code would credit 289 items (79%); one that only looked would credit 194 (53%). “Not seen” means not seen in our frames, which is either a real absence or an item our capture did not reach; Section 5.3 separates the two on items we removed ourselves, and Section 5.5 names the two disagreement directions as error classes E2 ( unobserved ) and E3 ( unattributed ).
paragraphs.zh: WC003 每个世界检查 73 个必要项，总计 365 个。 对于每一项，裁判都有一个代码判定和一个帧判定（表 3）。 它们在 250 个项目上一致，在 115 个项目上存在分歧（占 32%），每个世界的分歧率在 26% 到 41% 之间。 分歧存在明显偏向：在 105 个项目中，代码被识别出但没有任何帧显示该项目，而反向情况仅有 10 个。 如果裁判仅阅读代码，则会认可 289 个项目（占 79%）；如果仅通过观察判断，则会认可 194 个（占 53%）。“未看到”意味着在我们的帧中未观察到该项目，这可能是实际不存在，也可能是我们的捕捉过程未能覆盖到该项目；第 5.3 节针对我们自行移除的项目区分了这两种情况，而第 5.5 节将两种分歧方向分别命名为错误类别 E2（未观察到）和 E3（未归因）。

paragraphs.en: To test whether exploring matters, we re-ran WC003’s visual judge on the same saved frames with the navigator’s close views removed, leaving the overview and four fixed orbits, which is what a snapshot judge has. Prompt, items and judge are unchanged (Table 4 ). Close views see more required items (194 against 178), but not by a wide margin, and the two sets differ: 42 items are seen only up close and 26 only in the wide views. The close-only items are small contents (animals account for 12 of the 42, followed by flowers, tall grass, vines and rain shafts). The wide-only items are biome-scale layout and weather (swamp channels, river mouths, islands, flat basins, mist, ash). The code probe independently supports 81% of the extra sightings on both sides, so neither set is mostly hallucinated. Totals barely move (320.2 against 322.1 WC003 points over five worlds), but individual worlds do: grok-4-7 loses 5.5 points without close views and gemini-3-1-pro gains 8.9, which swaps kimi-k-3 and grok-4-7 in the WC003 ranking. Exploration matters for coverage, not because any one camera is better. Two caveats apply: the close condition gave the judge two images per biome and the wide one five, and the navigator confirmed only 5 of 10 biomes in grok-4-7 ’s world.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试探索是否重要，我们对相同的已保存帧重新运行了 WC003 的视觉判断器，但移除了导航员的近景视图，仅保留全景和四个固定轨道视图，这与快照判断器所具备的视图一致。 提示、项目内容和判断器均未改变（表 4）。 近景视图能看到更多所需项目（194 个，对比 178 个），但差距并不显著，且两组数据存在差异：有 42 个项目仅在近距离可见，另有 26 个项目仅在全景中可见。 仅限近景可见的项目均为小型内容（动物占这 42 个中的 12 个，其次是花朵、高草、藤蔓和雨柱）。 仅限全景可见的项目则涉及生物群系尺度的布局与天气（沼泽通道、河流入海口、岛屿、平坦盆地、雾气、灰烬）。 代码探针独立支持了两侧额外观测到的 81% 的项目，因此两组数据中均不存在大部分为幻觉的情况。 总分变化极小（五个世界中 WC003 的得分从 320.2 变为 322.1），但单个世界的得分存在差异：grok-4-7 在没有近景视图的情况下损失了 5.5 分，而 gemini-3-1-pro 则获得了 8.9 分，这一变化使得 kimi-k-3 和 grok-4-7 在 WC003 的排名中发生了互换。 探索对覆盖范围至关重要，但这并非因为某一台摄像头更优。 需注意两点：近景条件使判断器每个生物群系获得了两张图像，而全景条件则提供了五张；此外，导航员在 grok-4-7 的世界中仅确认了 10 个生物群系中的 5 个。

paragraphs.en: Since there is no reference answer to annotate, we create ground truth by construction , as in mutation testing [ 7 ] . In a copy of claude-fable-5-1 ’s world we remove features, then re-run capture and WC003 on the changed biomes (Table 5 ). One feature is deleted outright. Three are made dead code : the function that builds them stays in the file but is never called. A fourth is disabled in place ( if(false) ). paragraphs.en: A code-only judge credits all four features whose code is still in the file, at full value, quoting real lines such as the kept function cactus(…) definition. Our frames half sees none of the cacti, mangroves or palms and cuts each to half credit: removed items keep 3.55 of their 7.11 points under our judge, against 5.44 under code-only judging. One removal slips through entirely: the disabled blizzard, where the probe quoted the switched-off line and the visual judge read drifting snowfall near the peaks as a blizzard. A snapshot-only judge is strictest here (1.67 points kept), but Section 5.2 shows it also misses real close-up items. Two findings bound these numbers. First, our code half still accepts code that never runs, so dead code earns half credit (Section 6 ). Second, single-run item verdicts are noisy: 7 of 32 items we did not touch changed verdict between the original run and this one. A sixth removal (volcanic ash) is excluded because the item also accepts eruption particles, and the volcano’s lava bombs, which we did not remove, still provide them; the judge was right to keep crediting it.

paragraphs.en: We classify every point lost on WC003 and WC004 (378.3 points over the five worlds) by the state of its item’s two channels. The code channel is positive when a verified quote exists (Section 4.2 ); the frames channel is positive when a blind-confirmed frame shows the item (Section 4.1 ). This gives four error classes (Table 7 ), used with these names throughout.
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 WC003 和 WC004 中丢失的每个分数（五个世界共 378.3 分）按照其物品两个通道的状态进行分类。 当存在经过验证的引文时，代码通道为正值（第 4.2 节）；当盲确认帧显示该物品时，帧通道为正值（第 4.1 节）。 由此得到四种错误类别（表 7），全文均使用这些名称。

paragraphs.en: E1 dominates (48.0%). E2 is the second largest (32.4%), and it is exactly the set a code-only judge would have credited, so a third of all losses lie in the gap this benchmark measures. E3 (8.9%) is the reverse gap, closed in part by the evidence-agent recheck; E4 is rare (3.9%), and the last 6.7% are penalties and gates, which no channel explains. The class definitions are operational, not causal: E1 is an upper bound on true absence, because it is the code probe’s verdict, and E2 includes items that exist but that capture did not reach (Section 6 ).
paragraphs.zh: E1 占据主导地位（48.0%）。 E2 是第二大类别（32.4%），恰好是仅依赖代码的判断器会认可的那部分，因此所有损失中约有三分之一源于该基准所衡量的这一差距。 E3（8.9%）代表反向差距，其中一部分通过证据-智能体复核得以弥合；E4 则较为罕见（3.9%），而最后 6.7% 是处罚和关卡，这些目前没有任何通道能够解释。 这些类别的定义是操作性的，而非因果性的：E1 是对真实缺失情况的一个上限，因为它是代码探针的判定结果；而 E2 则包含那些确实存在但未被捕获机制识别到的项目（第 6 节）。

paragraphs.en: The class mix differs per world (Figure 9 ). gemini-3-1-pro ’s losses are mostly E1. grok-4-7 has the most E2 points, partly a capture effect: the navigator confirmed only five of its ten biomes (Section 5.2 ). gpt-6-astra has the most E4 points.
paragraphs.zh: 各类混合因世界而异（图9）。gemini-3-1-pro 的损失主要源于 E1。grok-4-7 的 E2 分数最高，部分原因是捕获效应：导航员仅确认了其十个生物群系中的五个（第5.2节）。gpt-6-astra 的 E4 分数最高。

paragraphs.en: Wet and detailed regions lose the most points (Figure 10 ). The jungle is among the four hardest biomes for every model, and the grassland is the easiest for every model. On average jungle loses 53% of its points, delta 51%, swamp 51% and grove 50%, against 11% for the open grassland. 4 items are E1 for all five models, all small life (forest-floor cover and ferns, the grove’s pollinators and bees).
paragraphs.zh: 潮湿且细节丰富的区域扣分最多（图 10）。 对每个模型而言，丛林都是最难处理的四种生物群落之一，而草原则是最容易处理的。 平均而言，丛林会损失 53% 的分数，三角洲为 51%，沼泽为 51%，林间空地则为 50%，而开阔的草原仅损失 11%。在所有五个模型中，有 4 项为 E1，均为小型生物（森林地面覆盖物和蕨类植物、林间空地的传粉者和蜜蜂）。

paragraphs.en: The code half asks whether a quote is real text in the source, not whether that code ever runs. In the mutation test, three features whose functions were kept but never called still earned their code half, and a feature switched off with if(false) was quoted by its disabled line. Checking that quoted code is reachable from the world’s build or frame loop would close most of this gap.
paragraphs.zh: 代码部分关注的是引文在源代码中是否为真实文本，而非该代码是否曾被执行。 在变异测试中，三个功能得以保留但从未被调用的特征仍然获得了其代码部分的分数，而一个通过 if(false) 关闭的特征则由其禁用行进行了引用。 验证被引用的代码是否可以从世界的构建或帧循环中访问到，将能填补这一差距的大部分问题。

paragraphs.en: WC002’s neighbour list comes from a model reading the layout code, and unlike the item quotes it is not checked pair by pair. Against the actual biome maps of four worlds it is right on 61 of 76 rule-relevant pairs (of 19 each: claude-fable-5-1 17, kimi-k-3 14, gemini-3-1-pro 14, and 16 on claude-opus-5-5 , a world outside the five reported here). The other two reported worlds, including grok-4-7 , which tops placement, have no such map, so their placement scores are unchecked. The errors are mostly missed links, so a world can lose a placement point for a border it does have. Reading each world’s own biome map from the running page would make this exact, but the code that stores that map differs in every world. In a trial on the same four worlds, a model asked to locate it reproduced the exact map on its first attempt in two; in the other two it missed a biome or returned values it could not map.
paragraphs.zh: WC002 的邻居列表来自一个读取布局代码的模型，与物品报价不同，它不会逐对检查。 对照四个世界的实际生物群系地图，在 76 个与规则相关的配对中（每个世界各 19 对：claude-fable-5-1 有 17 对，kimi-k-3 有 14 对，gemini-3-1-pro 有 14 对，以及 claude-opus-5-5 有 16 对，后者是一个未在此处报告的第五个世界），结果完全正确。 另外两个已报告的世界，包括在排名中领先的 grok-4-7，都没有这样的地图，因此它们的排名得分未经核实。 错误主要是遗漏的链接，因此一个世界可能因实际存在的边界而失去一个排名积分。 从运行页面读取每个世界自身的生物群系地图将使结果完全准确，但存储该地图的代码在每个世界中都不同。 在针对同一四个世界的测试中，一个被要求定位该地图的模型在两次尝试中首次就还原了精确的地图；而在另外两个世界中，它要么遗漏了一个生物群系，要么返回了无法映射的值。

paragraphs.en: We grade one world per model, from one prompt, once, and single item verdicts are noisy (Section 5.3 ). Totals are steadier, but we treat gaps of a few points between neighbouring models as ties and do not claim a ranking among them. The mutation test covers five removals in one world. Repeated generations and repeated grading would give the variance this paper does not report.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对每个模型基于一个提示词、一次评估，对单个结果进行评分，但这些单一结果的判断存在噪声（第 5.3 节）。 总分更为稳定，但我们认为相邻模型之间相差几分的情况属于并列，因此不在它们之间确定排名。 该突变测试涵盖了一个世界中的五次移除操作。 重复的生成过程和重复的评分将产生本文未报告的方差。

paragraphs.en: A world written as code has to be graded twice, once for what the program says and once for what it shows, because the two disagree on a third of items, mostly code that no frame shows, and neither can say alone which is right. WorldBench grades both: it explores the running world close and wide, reads the code for what it is looking at, and lets an item score only for evidence that survives a check against the source or the pixels. Placement is the one reading we do not verify item by item; on four worlds it matched the biome map on 61 of 76 pairs (Section 6 ). Removing features on purpose shows the gain over reading alone, and the gap that remains: code that exists but never runs.
paragraphs.zh: 一个以代码形式编写的世界必须经过两次评分：一次依据程序所陈述的内容，另一次依据其实际表现。因为两者在三分之一的条目上存在分歧——这些条目大多是任何画面都无法显示的代码，而仅凭其中任何一方也无法断定孰对孰错。 WorldBench 会同时执行这两种评分：它会对运行中的世界进行广泛而深入的探索，读取代码中正在观察的内容，并仅对那些经过与源代码或像素画面比对后仍能成立的证据给予评分。 位置匹配是我们唯一没有逐条验证的读取方式；在四个世界中，它在 76 对数据中有 61 对与生物群系地图相匹配（第 6 节）。 有意移除某些特征可以凸显单纯依赖读取信息的局限性，以及由此留下的空白：那些存在却从未运行的代码。

paragraphs.en: Build a single, self-contained HTML file that renders the world described below as an explorable 3D scene using Three.js (CDN import is fine -- no build step, no separate asset files). It must just open in a browser and run, with a free camera (e.g. OrbitControls) so a visitor can orbit, zoom, and pan around the whole world. Include a simple on-screen UI so a visitor can navigate and read the world easily (see UI section below). Output ONLY the complete HTML file -- no prose, no commentary, no code fences. Choose your own overall scale. What matters is relative placement, ecological causality, and clear visual reading from orbit -- not any particular absolute size or fixed elevation numbers. -------------------------------------------------------- THE WORLD -------------------------------------------------------- # Floating Biome Island with Ocean -- World Description ## Visual style (required) Minecraft-like voxel / block aesthetic throughout: - Terrain, cliffs, water, lava, trees, flora, and structures are built from chunky axis-aligned cubes and blocky stacked forms -- not smooth organic meshes, not photoreal terrain, not low-poly "soft" stylization. - Flat, solid face colors (Lambert / unlit-friendly); no PBR gloss, no detailed textures required. Pixel-chunk readability from orbit. - Trees and plants are stacked blocks / simple voxel silhouettes (trunk + canopy cubes), not billboards or smooth cones. - Weather and particles can be simple quads or small cubes, but the landmass itself must read as a voxel island. ## Overview A floating landmass hangs motionless in an infinite black void. Viewed from a high orbit, nearly the entire surface should be readable at once. Each biome needs room to read as its own region -- distinct transitions, not a muddled cluster. Flora and fauna should feel alive inside each biome without overcrowding the whole island. Much of the outer perimeter is bordered by shallow coastal ocean and sandy beaches before terrain rises inland. Elevations are exaggerated and dramatic relative to each other: peaks dominate, shelves sit mid-height, plains are low and open, cliffs drop sharply. The ocean is suspended with the island and ends at cliff edges where waterfalls plunge into darkness. ## World layout (relationships) Compose a coherent ecological sequence. paragraphs.en: Snow mountains occupy the far / behind end of the island -- the final alpine massif at the cold edge. 2. Snowy conifer forest sits as elevated foothills in front of those mountains (between the peaks and the rest of the island). 3. Highlands occupy an elevated plain to the side of the snow forest -- between the mountain flank and the back side of the flowering grove -- then slope gently down into that pink grove. 4. Dense jungle is a large wet canopy region, with a backwater / swamp marsh on the jungle’s far side (away from the main plains outlet). 5. Flat grassland plateau is the open river plain that receives wet- corridor drainage and leads toward the coast. 6. Flowering grove is a moist pink basin off the plains / below the highland slope -- visually separate from green grassland. 7. Desert is a vast arid basin (south / rain-shadow side) with its own sandstone desert mountains -- never the volcano. 8. Volcano is a separate tall cone on volcanic ground only (far from the desert’s river path). 9. Coastal ocean and beaches wrap much of the southern and western edge. ## Scale and density (qualitative) - Prefer a clearly legible island: biomes spaced so each reads as its own region from high orbit. - Avoid collapsing adjacent biomes -- especially grassland vs flowering grove, desert vs volcano, snow forest vs alpine peaks. - Within each biome, flora and fauna should feel abundant for that climate (dense jungle canopy; cactus across desert flats; pines in the snow forest; sparse scrub on highlands). - Mountains and the volcano dominate the skyline; desert flats and the grassland plateau sit lower between them. ## Fauna Voxel / blocky animals (stacked cubes, same aesthetic as the land) -- simple silhouettes are enough; place them where they belong: - Deer or similar grazers in jungle edges, grasslands, grove, conifers - Foxes or small arid / marsh creatures in desert and swamp - Occasional coastal or river life near beaches and deltas if it fits - Enough motion or presence to feel alive, not empty dioramas -- without overcrowding ## Ecological reasoning Layout and systems must follow ecological logic, not decoration: - Water stays in the wet corridor: mountain melt -> through / past the snow-forest foothills and wet highlands -> weave through jungle -> flat grasslands -> coastal delta / ocean. - Flowering grove is a moist offshoot below the highland slope / plains moisture -- not a stop on the way into the desert.

paragraphs.en: - Desert is arid: vast flat basin with sandstone desert mountains; cacti across the flats; only fading dry washes; no through-rivers into the volcano; no perennial river cutting the desert core. - Volcano is a separate tall cone with lava tributaries and lava pools on volcanic ground. Where water meets lava, rock quenches to obsidian. - Rain falls downward from moving cloud decks over wet biomes. - Snowfall comes from cloud decks over the snowy conifer forest. - Blizzard / white windstorm lives on the behind face of the snow mountains (the far alpine side), not as a front-slope decoration facing the forest alone. - Snowy trees carry snow on their canopies, not only on the ground. - Highlands are genuinely elevated relative to plains and grove, with a gentle downslope into the pink forest. ## Biomes ### 1. Snow Mountain Range (far / behind) - Tall alpine peaks -- high relief, not gentle hills - Snow on summits and upper ridges; rock on lower slopes - Meltwater feeding the wet corridor - Active blizzard on the behind mountain face: fast whitish wind sheets (sandstorm motion, white instead of brown), spanning a wide strip of that rear alpine tape ### 2. Snowy Conifer Forest (foothills in front of the peaks) - Elevated shelf / foothill band in front of the snow mountains - Dense pines with snow on canopies as well as ground - Cloud deck directly above the forest that drops snowfall onto it - Distinct from both bare alpine rock and lowland plains ### 3. Temperate Highlands (elevated plain beside the snow forest) - Sit to the side of the snow forest, between mountain influence and the back of the flowering grove -- an elevated open highland plain - Higher than grasslands and grove; rocky hills, scrub, hardy plants - Gentle slope down into the pink flowering grove - Occasional mist and light rain ### 4. Dense Jungle / Rainforest - Thick emerald canopy, layered undergrowth, densely packed trees - Rocky clearings, inland ponds, major waterfall - On the jungle’s backside (away from the plains outlet): a backwater / swamp ecosystem -- murky standing pools, mangroves or similar, low mist, stagnant channels (not a desert river) - Persistent jungle rain: rainfall shafts, wet canopy, rising mist after showers ### 5. Central Grasslands (flat river plateau) - Open flat green plain -- clearly not the pink grove - Dense winding river network with many tributaries - Scattered woodland copses and yellow/white wildflowers - Meadow color green/olive, not pink ### 6.
paragraphs.zh: - 沙漠是干旱的：一片广阔的平坦盆地，有砂岩沙漠山脉；平地上遍布仙人掌；只有逐渐消失的干涸河床；没有河流穿过火山；也没有常年河流切割沙漠核心。- 火山是一个独立的高耸锥体，火山地面上有熔岩支流和熔岩池。 水与熔岩相遇之处，岩石冷却成黑曜石。- 雨水从移动的云层中向下落在湿润的生物群系上。- 降雪来自覆盖着雪松针叶林的云层。- 暴风雪/白色风暴存在于雪山背面（远侧的高山地带），而不仅仅是面向森林的前坡装饰。- 雪松树上覆盖着积雪，而不仅仅是地面。- 高地相对于平原和树林确实更高，并平缓地向下倾斜至粉色森林。## 生物群系 ### 1. 雪山山脉（远侧/背面）- 高耸的高山峰顶——地形起伏大，而非平缓的小山——山顶和上部山脊覆盖着积雪；下部山坡为岩石——融水为湿润走廊提供水源——雪山背面有活跃的暴风雪：快速移动的白色风带（类似沙尘暴的运动，但呈白色而非棕色），覆盖着后部高山带的宽阔区域 ### 2. 雪松针叶林（峰顶前方的山麓）- 位于雪山前方的抬升平台/山麓带——茂密的松树，树冠和地面都覆盖着积雪——云层直接位于森林上方，并在此处形成降雪——与裸露的高山岩石和低地平原明显不同 ### 3. 温带高地（雪松森林旁的抬升平原）- 位于雪松森林的侧面，处于山脉影响区与开花树林后方之间——一片抬升的开阔高海拔平原——高于草原和树林；有岩石小山、灌木和耐旱植物——平缓地向下倾斜至粉色开花树林——偶尔有薄雾和小雨 ### 4. 茂密丛林/雨林 - 浓密的翠绿色树冠，分层的下层植被，树木密集——岩石空地、内陆池塘和大型瀑布——在丛林的背面（远离平原出口处）：一个背水/沼泽生态系统——浑浊的静水池、红树林或类似植物、低层薄雾、停滞的水道（而非沙漠河流）——持续的丛林降雨：降雨带、湿润的树冠，雨后升起薄雾 ### 5. 中央草原（平坦的河流高原）- 开阔的平坦绿色平原——明显不是粉色树林——密集的蜿蜒河流网络，伴有众多支流——零散的林地灌木丛和黄/白色野花——草地呈绿色/橄榄色，而非粉色 ### 6.

paragraphs.en: ## UI (required for easy navigation) Keep the HUD minimal and readable over the black void: - Biome legend: color swatch + biome name for every major region (mountains, snow forest, highlands, jungle, swamp, grasslands, flowering grove, desert, volcano, coast / ocean). Optionally note each biome’s weather flavor (rain, blizzard, sandstorm, etc.). - Click (or tap) a legend entry to fly / animate the camera to that biome; include a "whole island" overview entry that returns to a comfortable high orbit. - Season readout: show the current season name on screen and update it as the seasonal cycle advances. - Brief control hint in the legend footer (e.g. orbit / zoom / pan). ## Cliffs and Underside - Vertical rock walls around the perimeter - Tall stone foundation matching heightened elevations above - Numerous waterfalls; floating rock fragments beneath - Blue glowing mineral seams in places ## Color Palette Region Colors ------------ ----------------------------- Ocean Turquoise, deep blue, cyan Beaches White, cream, tan Jungle Emerald, dark green, mist grey Swamp Murky olive, dark water Plains Green, olive Grove Pink blossoms, soft meadow Highlands Grey-green scrub Mountains White summits, blue-grey rock Conifers Dark pine, snow-capped canopy Desert Gold, ochre, dust haze Volcano Black, orange, crimson, ash Rivers Cyan (murkier in swamp) Weather Rain blue, snow white, sand tan, ash grey ## Lighting - Square sun drives a full day -> night cycle; seasonal tint modulates warmth - Nights are clearly darker than noon (ambient + sun intensity drop) - Local weather tinting (cooler in storms, ember glow near volcano) - Crisp terrain shadows when weather is clear - High visibility of the whole island from a comfortable orbit by day - Black void background with no stars or atmosphere dome ## Visual Composition A Minecraft-style voxel floating continent: far snow mountains with a behind-face blizzard; elevated snow-forest foothills under snowfall clouds; highlands on an elevated plain sloping into a pink grove; a large dense jungle with a backwater swamp on its far side; a flat grassland river plateau; arid desert with its own sandstone mountains separated from a tall erupting volcano; wet-corridor rivers to a coastal delta; cyclic weather; square sun with day/night and seasons; clickable biome legend and season HUD. The ocean borders the land before plunging over cliff edges into the void.
paragraphs.zh: ## 用户界面（便于导航所必需）在黑色虚空之上保持 HUD 简洁且清晰易读：- 生物群系图例：每个主要区域（山脉、雪林、高地、丛林、沼泽、草原、花谷、沙漠、火山、海岸/海洋）均配有颜色样本和名称。 可选地标注每个生物群系的气候特征（雨、暴风雪、沙尘暴等）。- 点击图例条目即可飞行或动画化镜头至该生物群系；包含一个“全岛”概览条目，可返回舒适的较高轨道。- 季节显示：在屏幕上显示当前季节名称，并随季节循环推进而更新。- 在图例底部提供简要操作提示（例如：环绕/缩放/平移）。## 悬崖与底部 - 边缘环绕着垂直岩壁 - 高大的石基与上方抬高的地形相匹配 - 多处瀑布；下方有漂浮的岩石碎片 - 部分区域可见蓝色发光的矿物脉带 ## 色彩方案 区域颜色 ------------ ----------------------------- 海洋 青绿色、深蓝色、青色 海滩 白色、奶油色、棕黄色 丛林 翡翠绿、深绿色、灰绿色 沼泽 浑浊的橄榄绿、深褐色水域 平原 绿色、橄榄绿 花谷 粉色花朵、柔和的草地 高地 灰绿色灌木 山脉 白色峰顶、蓝灰色岩石 针叶林 深松色、积雪覆盖的树冠 沙漠 金色、赭石色、尘埃 haze 火山 黑色、橙色、深红色、灰烬 河流 青色（沼泽中更浑浊） 天气 雨为蓝色，雪为白色，沙尘暴为棕黄色，灰雾为灰色 ## 光照 - 方形太阳驱动完整的昼夜循环；季节性色调调节温暖感 - 夜晚明显比白天更暗（环境光与太阳光强度均下降） - 局部天气带来的色调变化（暴风雨中更冷，火山附近有炽热光芒） - 天气晴朗时地形阴影清晰 - 白天从舒适的轨道上可清晰看到全岛 - 背景为黑色虚空，无星星或大气穹顶 ## 视觉构图 一个 Minecraft 风格的浮空大陆：远处的雪山后方有暴风雪；抬高的雪林山麓位于降雪云层之下；高地坐落在抬高的平原上，向粉色花谷倾斜；一片大型茂密丛林，其远侧有一个背水沼泽；平坦的草原河流高原；干旱的沙漠及其独立的砂岩山脉，与一座高耸的喷发火山分离；湿润走廊河流流向沿海三角洲；循环天气；方形太阳带来昼夜和季节变化；可点击的生物群系图例和季节 HUD。 海洋环绕着陆地，随后从悬崖边缘坠入虚空。

paragraphs.en: Figure 15 shows WC001’s two halves on the reference world. paragraphs.en: The judge in Section 4 was not designed up front. Each of its checks replaced a simpler judge that was built first, run on real worlds, and found to fail in a specific, measurable way. Table 11 lists them. Two patterns repeat. Judges that match the source text (keywords, patterns) reward what a program names , so they are easy to game and brittle under harmless rewrites. Judges that trust a model’s answer (a quote, a sighting, an “it changed”) accept fluent claims that are not true. Every replacement therefore anchors the claim to something the model under test cannot fake: the source text itself, or measured pixels.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4 节中的评判器并非预先设计好的。 它的每一项检查都取代了最初构建、在真实世界中运行并被发现以某种具体且可测量的方式失败的更简单评判器。表 11 列出了这些情况。其中存在两种重复的模式。 与源文本（关键词、模式）相匹配的评判器会奖励程序所命名的内容，因此它们容易被操控，并且在无害的重写操作下显得脆弱。 信任模型答案（引文、目击记录或“它改变了”）的评判器会接受那些并不真实的流畅陈述。 因此，每一项替换都将该陈述锚定到测试模型无法伪造的内容上：源文本本身，或是经过测量的像素值。

sents.zh: 因此，每一项替换都将该陈述锚定到测试模型无法伪造的内容上：源文本本身，或是经过测量的像素值。

paragraphs.en: The main text says “the judge” for readability. Several models fill distinct roles, and every role is set in one configuration file, so a run can be repeated with the same judges or a whole judge set swapped (Table 12 ).
paragraphs.zh: 为了便于阅读，正文中使用了“法官”这一表述。 多个模型承担着不同的角色，每个角色都在一个配置文件中设定，因此可以重复运行时使用相同的法官，或者替换整个法官组（表 12）。

paragraphs.en: Frames are sent to the vision judge at 896 px wide and to the navigator at 640 px. The navigator has 8 actions per biome; the evidence agent has 10 tool calls per search. Output is capped at 16,384 tokens per call, and each request times out after 300 s.
paragraphs.zh: 图像帧以 896 像素的宽度发送给视觉判官，并以 640 像素的宽度发送给导航员。 导航员在每个生物群落中有 8 个动作；证据智能体每次搜索有 10 次工具调用。 每次调用的输出最多为 16,384 个词元，且每个请求在 300 秒后会超时。

paragraphs.en: All six judge roles are Gemini or Gemma models, the same developer as one of the five models under test, gemini-3-1-pro . Judges are known to favour outputs from their own family [ 9 ] . The one comparison we have does not show favouritism: gemini-3-1-pro ranks last overall (149.00 of 280) and last on WC003 and WC004, the tests that rely most on the vision and code-probe judges. That is a single model, and a low score does not rule out a smaller bias. We did not run a cross-family judge to measure the effect directly.
paragraphs.zh: 所有六个评审角色都是 Gemini 或 Gemma 模型，与待测试的五个模型之一 gemini-3-1-pro 来自同一开发者。 已知评审者会倾向于选择自己所属模型家族生成的输出 [9]。 我们唯一进行的比较并未显示偏袒现象：gemini-3-1-pro 的整体排名垫底（280 分中得 149.00 分），在 WC003 和 WC004 测试中的排名也最低，而这两项测试最依赖视觉和代码探针评审者。 这只是一个单一模型，而且得分低并不能排除存在较小的偏见。 我们没有运行跨家族评审者来直接测量这种影响。
